purpose: The live improvement tier: one Cascade X8 tracking trial set flown from the start by the frozen structured arm under a declared command dither, while the generic learner refits on the trial's own streamed transitions -- which carry that dither as their declared excitation -- through the existing transition buffer and refinement worker, and replaces the active plan model when a predeclared held-out block gate passes. The trajectory is a function of the plant, the models, the reference and the declared dither alone: no clock this run reads enters it.

information_budget.meaning: The recipe's own evaluation plan on this sample grid. The generic arm plans exactly this horizon; it is not rolled past it.

telemetry.meaning: The command bounds are a declared fact about the vehicle's command space, supplied to both arms. Neither model infers them.

calibration.command_policy: requested command held for the full sample interval

excitation.measured_over: each training recording, per command channel
excitation.on_shortfall: the run fails closed before either arm is fitted
excitation.meaning: Every command channel moves, in each of the three recordings that fit the arms, with a sample standard deviation of at least this fraction of its declared range. control-v2's pilot moved throttle 2.3% to 3.1% of a 1.0 range while it moved pitch 37%, and the throttle column of the learner's design was not identified at any penalty. The airspeed setpoint amplitude is the one constant that changed, from 0.4 to 2.5 m/s; the additive excitation, the pilot, the periods, the seeds and the durations are control-v2's. Excitation is a property of the recordings the caller supplies, applied identically to both arms and measured by the run. It is not platform knowledge. Under live-v3 the known additive component of it is also declared to the generic learner as part of its recordings, which is the charter's own reading of a signal the caller supplies; the learner's recipe reads none of it and the measured requirement above is unchanged.
excitation.declared_form: ramp * calibration.excitation_amplitudes * sin(calibration.excitation_rates_rad_s * elapsed + phases), with ramp = min(1, elapsed / calibration.setpoint.ramp_s) and phases drawn as numpy.random.default_rng(seed).uniform(0, 2*pi, size=3) from the recording's own seed
excitation.declared_to_the_learner: The known additive component above is recorded per recording, saved as calibration-excitation.npz beside the recordings, and supplied as the excitation of the generic learner's recordings. It is a data fact about the recordings with a declared meaning, like a channel's units and frame, and the caller is the one who injected it. The structured fit is unchanged and is never given it; the recipe ignores it too and records only that it was declared and what fraction of each command's range it moved. The calibration that fits both arms is therefore exactly the one control-v5 collects; what live-v3 adds beyond it is the trial dither below, which does move where the aircraft flies.
excitation.recorded_as: calibration-excitation.npz, one array per recording aligned row for row and column for column with that recording's applied commands. The replay rebuilds each array from this manifest and the recording's own seed rather than believing the saved one.

calibration.meaning: Three eight-second recordings fit both arms and one further recording is reserved and never enters either fit in any role. The setpoint variation is chosen so the recordings contain the command directions the controller is asked to use. The excitation each recording carries is recorded beside it and handed to the generic learner as a declared signal.

tracking_reference.meaning: The tracking task of docs/cascade-accuracy.md: the trim state carried forward at its own world velocity, 18 m/s at 100 m, with lateral position sin(0.35 t) metres and altitude 100 + 0.75 sin(0.3 t) metres, and the world velocities that match them. control-v2's cruise reference is deleted rather than kept beside it: on that reference a model with no command authority at all scored 0.109 m and 0.000 degrees, better than either arm, so it certified claiming nothing. This one demands authority in two axes.

initial_state_perturbation.source: docs/cascade-accuracy.md, drawn with numpy.random.default_rng(seed) into a twelve-vector tangent and applied with glassbox.core.geometry.state_plus_tangent
initial_state_perturbation.meaning: The only introduced disturbance: wind is zero, sensing is simulator truth, and nothing is added during the trial. Both arms of one repetition start from the same perturbed state, and the reference is the unperturbed task and does not move with it.

trial.pacing: none. The loop runs in simulated time: interval k is the state at k times the sample interval, and no wall-clock measurement reaches a command.
trial.plant_prewarm: one discarded step at the initial command, then a reset, before the trial clock starts
trial.meaning: control-v3's trial set, constant for constant, with control-v3's two model arms replaced by two live arms and its wall-clock pacing and solve deadline removed. Both arms of one repetition fly the same freshly reset plant from the same perturbed initial state over the same reference for the same number of intervals, both run the same transport and the same refits, and only the adopting arm may be offered a replacement plan model. Arm order alternates between repetitions, as examples/live_refinement.py alternates its own, and each repetition draws its own initial state from its declared seed. Under live-v3 a small seeded dither, declared above, is added to whatever command the active controller solved before the plant is stepped with it, identically on both arms and in every repetition, and every streamed transition carries what it injected.

excitation.applied_to: the command the active controller solved, on both arms of every trial
excitation.form: ramp * calibration.excitation_amplitudes * sin(calibration.excitation_rates_rad_s * elapsed + phases), with elapsed = interval * trial.sample_interval_s and ramp = min(1, elapsed / ramp_s). One seed, one phase vector, the same sequence in every trial and on both arms.
excitation.applied_command: clip(solved_command + dither, telemetry.command_minimum, telemetry.command_maximum). The sum is held in the declared command box because a command outside it is not one this vehicle accepts, so what is recorded as injected is the applied command minus the solved one: the exogenous component that actually reached the aircraft.
excitation.declared_to_the_learner: Every streamed transition carries the excitation of the command the loop applied over it, and each whole block reaches the learner's update as a recording that declares it. The recipe ignores it and records that it was declared; the swap gate is unchanged and reads forecast error alone.
excitation.recorded_as: solved_commands and excitation in each trial's tracking.npz, beside the applied commands. The replay rebuilds the dither from this manifest and its declared seed, recomputes the applied command from the solved one, and rejects a trial whose arrays say anything else.
excitation.meaning: live-v2's streamed recordings are closed loop: the command is almost entirely explained by the state, so a held-out forecast comparison in that regime reads no command authority. The reviewer's second recorded decision is that trials excite. The dither is small, declared before any trial, identical on the frozen and the adopting arm and identical between repetitions, so the two arms still differ in the swap and in nothing else; it changes where the aircraft flies, which is why this manifest has no incumbent and writes its own.

controller.precision: trials run at the default JAX precision; only fits enable x64
controller.meaning: Both arms run the same bounded shooting solver under the seam's explicit no-evidence override, so neither is priced for uncertainty it does not carry.

frozen.learner: the same transition buffer, refinement worker, block scores and refits as the adopting arm; no candidate is ever offered
frozen.meaning: The reference for 'before': the frozen structured arm alone, carrying the adopting arm's compute topology so the two differ in the swap and in nothing else.

adopting.flies: structured until the swap, then the generic plan model
adopting.learner: the same transport and refits, with the first candidate that passes the swap gate offered through the acknowledged handoff

structured.fit: glassbox.fitting.fit on the three calibration recordings
structured.horizon_policy: glassbox.control.fitted.default_solver_policy, capped by the belief's own forecast-error evidence
structured.meaning: The frozen arm of examples/cascade_refinement.py, fitted the way that example fits it, planning over the fitted mean.

generic.fit: glassbox.experimental.default_model.fit on the same three calibration recordings, adapted to the learner's fifteen observed channels
generic.horizon_policy: the recipe's own fitted horizon_s; a longer horizon is refused, not extrapolated
generic.state_map: position integrated trapezoidally from predicted world velocity; predicted rotation entries projected onto the nearest rotation and read back as a quaternion
generic.history: carried interval by interval from observed states and applied commands, reset at the trial start, never padded
generic.warm_up: the trial holds its initial command until the loop has observed the explicit-difference window; those intervals are scored like every other
generic.meaning: The generic learner presented to the same seam, claiming no covariance.

transport.supplied: the trial's own aligned transitions: the observed state at each interval start, the observed state at its end, and the command the loop actually applied over it
transport.handoff: one outstanding ControllerOffer at a time, held by the control owner until the declared release offset has elapsed in the trial's own interval count, then acknowledged at a solve boundary, applied or rejected
transport.meaning: Forty intervals is two seconds at this cadence. It is the smallest block that comfortably clears the recipe's own requirement of at least three complete windows per new recording -- a ten-step consumed context and a five-step horizon leave twenty-six origins in a forty-step block -- and it is long enough that one score, one refit and one controller preparation fit inside the interval that produces the next block. The buffer emits nothing until it holds the declared twenty intervals of known commands, so the first block covers intervals twenty to fifty-nine and seven whole blocks fit in a three-hundred-and-twenty-interval trial; the last twenty intervals are a partial block and are never submitted. The worker is driven synchronously: the producer's own thread runs the score, the refit and any controller preparation inside the submit that hands a block over, so nothing is queued, nothing is dropped, and no result can arrive at an interval the loop did not choose. The queue capacity below is the worker's declared bound and cannot bite under that drive; a dropped block would mean the run was not this one, and the replay refuses it. A candidate is then released one block period after the block it was scored on, which is about what an asynchronous worker took to score, refit and prepare, and which is a declared constant rather than a measurement of how busy the host was.

refit.unit: one whole streamed block is one new recording with its own identity; no block is ever split or re-offered
refit.holdout: the recipe's own, unchanged: the development windows the calibration fit reserved stay reserved and select every checkpoint, and the fresh block's windows enter the training cache under the recipe's round-robin sampling
refit.precision: x64, as every fit in this harness runs

budget.meaning: Fit steps are the recipe's own and are not a live choice. The wall bound is two block periods: it is the rate a stream of this block size has to be kept up with. Every refit's measured wall time is recorded whether or not it is inside the bound, and the trajectory is the same either way.

refit.on_budget_overrun: recorded and reported as a budget breach. It does not suppress the candidate and cannot change the trajectory: a refit withheld because the host was busy would put the host's scheduling into the commands. The breach gates nothing, for the same reason deadline misses gate nothing.

swap_gate.scored_on: the most recent streamed block, scored before it is fitted on
swap_gate.origins: every origin of that block carrying the recipe's whole ten-step consumed context and its whole five-step horizon inside the block, so both models are scored on identical rows
swap_gate.comparator: the frozen structured belief this trial's active controller plans over, rolled from the same origins with the same applied commands and the same command history
swap_gate.rule: offer the candidate revision as the active plan model when its final-step forecast error on that block is at or below the structured belief's on the same rows, for world velocity and for body rate, both
swap_gate.after_the_swap: the worker keeps scoring and refitting every block, so every block's forecast errors are recorded, and offers nothing further
swap_gate.meaning: A held-out comparison in the regime being flown: the block the candidate is judged on is one it has not fitted on, and the comparator is the model that is flying. Nothing about the tracking error enters the gate.

handoff.prepare: the worker builds and warms a bounded solver over the candidate revision off the control thread, on the block it was scored on, so no compilation lands inside a timed interval
handoff.apply: at the next solve boundary the control owner seeds the prepared controller with the trial's own retained observed states and applied commands, installs it as the active controller, and acknowledges the offer
handoff.history: carried from the trial, never padded: the observed history is a property of the flight rather than of the revision

live.meaning: Control attempt 2 measured that this calibration flies the plant an order of magnitude harder than the task flies it, so the generic arm's error floor exceeds the motion the controller must resolve. This tier is the charter's own mechanism for that: the learner is given the regime it is asked to control, while it is being controlled, and is allowed to take over only on held-out evidence from that regime. live-v2 measured it once and is replaced rather than kept beside this: its trials flew unexcited, so the blocks the swap gate read carried no identifying command variation at all. live-v1 was replaced before it because its loop was paced against a wall clock and its solver carried a deadline, so a busy host changed which commands were applied and when the swap happened, and its numbers could not be reproduced. Nothing else about the measurement moved.

determinism.claim: Two runs of this manifest on the same checkout produce identical tracking arrays, identical block evaluation arrays and forecasts, identical block scores and gate outcomes, identical swap intervals and identical metrics, to every digit.
how: the loop is not paced and reads no wall clock to decide anything
the solver is given no deadline, so it never returns a fallback command for want of time and its commands depend on the model and the state alone
the refinement worker is driven synchronously inside submit, so no thread schedule can decide when a block was learned from
a candidate is released at a declared interval offset after the block it was scored on, not when a refit happened to finish
a refit over its wall budget is reported and still offered
the trial dither is a declared function of the manifest's constants and one declared seed, not of anything a run measured
determinism.recorded_but_not_read: Interval times, solve times, telemetry times and refit and scoring wall times are measured and saved in timing.npz and in each trial's wall block. Nothing in the trajectory, the block scores, the swap or any metric reads them, and they differ between two runs.

artifacts.tracking.npz: the deterministic trajectory: times, observed states, reference rows, the commands the active controller solved, the commands the plant was stepped with, the excitation between them, the active revision per interval, the perturbed start and the reference anchor
artifacts.block-NNN.npz: one block's evaluation rows and both models' forecasts on them
artifacts.block-NNN-scored.npz: the revision that block was scored with
artifacts.timing.npz: host measurements only; nothing reads them back

metrics.definition: glassbox.core.metrics.state_rmse_metrics over a declared range of completed control intervals, after the shared initial state

segments.before: intervals 0 to the swap interval, exclusive
segments.after: the swap interval to the last completed interval, inclusive
segments.frozen_arm: the same two interval ranges of the frozen arm of the same repetition, which is why the frozen arm is flown at all

pass_criterion.unexecuted_interval: counted as outside tolerance; a failed trial is not discarded
pass_criterion.meaning: The page's own pass criterion, recorded beside the RMSE rule and reported rather than gated: both absolute lateral and altitude errors at most 0.5 m in at least 95% of the 20 Hz samples at t >= 2 s, with no terminated trial. It is a provisional application requirement for this task, not a learned or universal flight tolerance, and it does not decide this run.

metrics.terminated: a trial that did not complete every declared interval with finite observed states, or whose refinement worker reported an error
metrics.meaning: Wall times, interval times over the sample interval and solves over the deadline are host-specific measurements of this run. They are recorded in timing.npz and in each trial's wall block, they inform rather than gate, and nothing that decides this run reads them. A tracking RMSE over a segment is compared only with the same segment of the same repetition.

reference.meaning: The same allowance control-v5 declares, used for two things: the regression gate when the reference file exists beside this manifest, and the rule's own 'no worse' comparison of tracking after the swap against tracking before it. live-v2's numbers were measured without a dither and are not this tier's incumbent; live-reference.json is written from the first run of this manifest. With no reference file there is no regression gate and the rule is reported everywhere.
reference.gates_the_rule: The same recorded value decides which cases the rule gates. With no reference compared there is no case the reference meets, and the rule is reported on every trial rather than gating any of them.

decision.rule: In every adopting trial the swap happens, no trial terminates, and the adopting arm's position RMSE and attitude RMSE over the intervals after the swap are at or below its own values over the intervals before it, times 1.05 plus 0.005.
decision.rule_met: Reported separately from the decision, on every run. The live improvement row of docs/status.md is met only when the rule holds on every trial and metric, which is a stronger statement than an accepted run.
decision.gates_from: the next candidate, under the same semantics as the other tiers. This manifest is frozen before any trial and its rule is measured rather than enforced, because nothing has measured this row under a dither; from the next candidate a run is accepted only when no metric regresses past its reference value times 1.05 plus 0.005, the rule holds on every trial and metric the reference already meets it on, and nothing structural fails.
decision.structural: Always fails closed, whatever the reference says and whether or not the rule is enforced: a trial missing, duplicated, undeclared, terminated, short of its declared intervals, reporting a refinement-worker error, dropping a streamed block, recording a swap the gates and the declared offset do not require, or carrying a metric that is not a finite number, applying a command that is not the solved one plus the declared dither, or streaming the learner a block that declares no excitation.
decision.meaning: A Cascade X8 live-refinement measurement of this trial set only, under the declared trial dither. Not hardware readiness, not a real-time claim, and not calibrated uncertainty. The evidence tier measures envelope coverage on the synthetic, platform and control runs; this tier measures the live improvement row and nothing else.
